preview_derivation: Resized and encoded WebP review previews; source pixels were not retouched. Source PNG hashes identify original generations.
references: Historical prompts bind two style-only input images. Those inputs are not distributed; their hashes identify the reference set. Supply your own authorized references before adapting these prompts.

examples.name: amara
observations: Pearl studs and off-center wavy bob make a distinct identity; broad shirt silhouette closely follows the intended streetwear proportions.
limitations: Shoe upper closures read as broad straps; materials macro uses laces. Fine rear pocket and sole geometry are generated interpretations.

examples.name: amara
observations: Rich close textile detail without a portrait panel. Lavender rib collar, ivory waistband/pleat and peach/cream sneaker colors are readable.
limitations: Shoe macro uses ordinary cord laces, while the selected character sheet shows a broad strap-like upper closure. Use for palette and tactile styling; selected character sheet controls exact footwear geometry.
Pocket/button placement, stitching density and sole segmentation vary from the full-body sheet; these are independently generated material details.

examples.name: sinag
observations: Variant has long sleeves and a closed marigold jacket chest; the sun ornament is restrained.
limitations: Sheet front full-body retains a second smaller readable face; close-up remains the authoritative face anchor. Exact small seam topology is synthesized rather than a geometric turnaround.

Cape ends near the knees and boots are tall rather than initial mid-thigh cape and ankle boots. These visible design variations can become canon if selected; do not reuse initial length descriptions downstream.

examples.name: sinag
observations: Cleanest entirely garment-only macro set: detached empty jacket, split cream cloth over aubergine weave, separate gauntlet and angular boot.
limitations: Material study preserves broad visual design but is not an exact garment-pattern specification; selected character sheet v01 remains authoritative for seam topology and small relief contours.
Empty jacket neckline reads rounder than the selected sheet standing collar; sun-ray curvature and boot sole segmentation vary. No skin, head or face is visible.

examples.name: sinag
observations: Material texture is strong, but this candidate needs tighter neck-down framing before selection.
limitations: Independent material generation changes ornamental relief or some garment seam/panel shapes relative to character-sheet canon.
Material studies variously alter the collar, torso panel geometry, jacket attachment and boot construction. Use the chosen sheet to constrain any replacement material render.
